preparedBy: AI authoring assistant (Claude) at the owner's request
statement: Every statement the course teaches, and every rule the simulation follows, is a claim with an entry here. Nothing in this register is clinical approval. Every decision reads NOT REVIEWED: no reviewer, role, date or reviewed revision is recorded, and an empty decision is not approval. Device facts are held in the device definitions, with their own fact-check records.

claims.assertion: With the port open and the fluid drained, air enters the pleural space and the lung falls away from the chest wall.
claims.context: An adult breathing spontaneously, lying on the side with the examined side up, with a free pleural space and no adhesions.
claims.sourceNote: No source has been read for this relationship yet. It is the one relationship the survey lesson cannot exist without.
dependentRules: The lung state follows the learner's air-entry control.
claims.limitations: The model shows a change of shape. It shows no pressure, no physiology and no rate, and it does not show a lung that fails to fall away.

shownBeforeReview.basis: Owner decisions, open item T2. A default, not a decision.

claims.assertion: In the collapsed state the lung surface sits at an authored distance from the port, chosen so that the survey has room to work.
claims.context: The same patient and position as MT-C-0001.
claims.sourceNote: The distance is chosen by the author. It is not measured and not taken from a source.
dependentRules: What the survey can reach and see depends on where the collapsed lung sits.
claims.limitations: Illustrative. A real lung collapses by an amount that varies with the patient and the disease.

claims.assertion: The prototype places its one port in the right seventh intercostal space on the mid-axillary line.
claims.context: This scan only. It is the highest space on the scan at which the skin, the chest wall and the gap between the ribs can all be measured.
claims.sourceNote: Chosen by the author from measurements of the scan. It is a teaching example and is not taken from a source.
dependentRules: The pivot, the corridor through the wall and the tilt limits all follow from the port.
claims.limitations: A port site is chosen for each patient, with ultrasound. This one is never described as a safe site, a recommended site or a usual site.

shownBeforeReview.basis: Owner decisions, open item T6. A default, not a decision.
